summary.zh: 把“领取”按钮做成一台抓娃娃机：爪子挂在绳子上跟着指针跑、会甩，下探夹住一只幽灵猫玩偶（压扁、眯眼），提起来晃着送进出口，玩偶从小门里蹦到托盘上。偶尔会滑掉。没人碰时有根手指在演示。
summary.en: A “claim” button as a claw machine: the claw hangs on a cable, chases your pointer and swings, drops to grab a ghost cat plush (it squashes and squints), carries it swaying to the chute, and the plush hops out of the prize door. Sometimes it slips. A ghost finger demos it when idle.

technique.zh: 小车是一根阻尼弹簧（跟着目标 x 走，会过冲一点），爪子是挂在小车上的单摆：角加速度 = −g/L·sinθ − 阻尼·ω − 小车加速度/L·cosθ，所以小车一急停爪子就往前甩。下探 / 提起 / 开合爪用补间，玩偶夹住时挪进爪子的坐标系里一起摆，放开时再换算回场景坐标做自由落体。按钮是真的 <button>，← → 移动、空格抓。
technique.en: The carriage is a damped spring (follows the target x with a little overshoot); the claw is a pendulum hanging from it: angular accel = −g/L·sinθ − damping·ω − carriageAccel/L·cosθ, so it swings forward whenever the carriage brakes. Drop / lift / open use tweens; a grabbed plush is re-parented into the claw so it swings along, and on release it’s converted back to scene coordinates and falls freely. The button is a real <button>: ← → to move, Space to grab.

desc.zh: 小车弹簧刚度（越大越跟手）
小车阻尼比（<1 会过冲）
绳子摆动的“重力”，越大摆得越快

adapt.zh: 适合抽奖、领取优惠券、每日签到这类“领一下”的按钮。真实场景里把结果（抓到 / 滑掉）交给后端，前端只负责把动画演完。
adapt.en: Great for raffles, coupon claims or daily check-in buttons. In production let the backend decide the result (caught / slipped); the front end just plays it out.
